comment: runAsNonRoot producer-rule table. Per row: pod is the pod spec's securityContext.runAsNonRoot (null = unset). Each container: kind is init | sidecar | regular | ephemeral, own is its securityContext.runAsNonRoot (null = unset), stamp is the box Container.security_context.run_as_non_root the producer must send (null = no SecurityContext message at all), effective is the kubelet's per-container verdict. podField is the box PodSecurityContext.run_as_non_root (null = no PodSecurityContext message at all). The consumer composition (container stamp OR podField) must equal effective on every row, except a row marked failClosed: an ephemeral container's opt-out never lowers the pod field (the field must not change mid-life), so the consumer still enforces it.

rows.name: pod true, container unset: both stamped true
pod true, one container opts out: it is false, the pod field drops, siblings stay true
pod unset, container true: the container carries its own value
pod unset, nothing set: no stamps and no pod context
pod false: every container stamped false
pod false, container true: the container's requirement stands
init and sidecar containers are stamped like regular ones
a sidecar opting out lowers the pod field; init and regular stay true
an ephemeral container is stamped from the pod spec value
an ephemeral container appended to a pod whose regular container opts out still resolves against the pod spec (true)
an ephemeral container opting out never lowers the pod field, so it is still enforced (fail closed)
pod unset, ephemeral container true: it carries its own value
